text: Jada has her driving test on Friday morning. It's her third attempt and she's properly nervous. Text her good luck on Thursday night.
Yuki is obsessed with Gunpla at the moment. She showed me a Zaku she built over half term, every panel line done by hand.
Fiona's daughter Eilidh gets her Higher results on 4 August 2027. Fiona says she's more anxious than Eilidh is.
Nora passed her grade 6 piano exam with distinction! Must send her a card this week.

Lunch with Caitlin and Natasha. Natasha's brother Callum has his medical school interview next Tuesday, and she said he's barely sleeping. Caitlin is off to Lisbon at the weekend with her partner. I'm feeding their cat Biscuit while they're away.
Saanvi supports Leicester and still hasn't recovered from relegation. Don't bring up football with her dad either, he's worse.
Anjali got into the Royal Northern for cello. Her audition was back in February and she's only just heard. Congratulate her properly when I see her on Sunday.
Deepa's mum is having a hip replacement on 12 November 2026. Deepa is taking the week off to look after her.
Simone mentioned she's learning to knit socks, which apparently is the hardest thing. She'd love some nice merino yarn for Christmas.
Abdi's theory test was yesterday. I need to ask him how it went.
Joanna and her husband Oscar are celebrating ten years married on Saturday. They're doing a weekend in the Cotswolds.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and book the car in for its MOT.

Aiko is sitting the JLPT N2 in December. She's been studying kanji every night after work and says she feels completely out of her depth. Her sister Manon did N1 last year and keeps quizzing her over dinner, which isn't helping. Maybe offer to do some practice papers with her one evening next week.
Kasia has started a pottery class on Wednesdays. She's mostly making very wonky mugs.
Rang Zofia. Her dog Pickle had an operation on his leg this morning and he's groggy but fine. She sounded exhausted.
Marisol's audition for the panto is a week on Monday. She's going for the Fairy Godmother.
Kieran's gig at the Brudenell got cancelled because the venue flooded. They're trying to rebook for March 2027.
Mihai is a massive chess nerd. Plays blitz online every lunch break and is rated about 1900. He follows the Candidates like other people follow the Premier League.
Eduardo's son is retaking his maths GCSE in November. Eduardo seems more worried than the boy.
Santiago, or Santi as everyone calls him, just joined our five-a-side team. He's a Real Madrid fan and won't let anyone forget it.
Erin finished her final exams today. Remind me to take her out for a drink on Friday to celebrate.
Esther's grandson was born on Tuesday, 7lb 2oz. His name is Theo. Her daughter is doing well.

Coffee with Aditi this afternoon. She got her driving test result back and she failed on a roundabout, poor thing. She's rebooked for 15 January 2027 but the wait is killing her. Her boyfriend Owen has offered to take her out practising every weekend until then. I should check in with her before Christmas.
Sinead has two cats, Mabel and Pip, and is thinking about getting a third.
Kenji's band are playing at the Leadmill a fortnight from Saturday. He plays bass. Get tickets for me and Callum.
Owen is doing his CFA Level 2 in May 2027. His firm is paying for it, but he's worried about fitting the study in around the baby.
Jada's brother Abdi has his A-level results on Thursday. Their mum is apparently already planning a party.
Message Fiona tomorrow to see how her interview went.

Yuki and her girlfriend Kasia are moving to Bristol at the end of November. Kasia got a job at the university there. They're having leaving drinks at the Crown on Friday 27 November. Yuki is gutted about leaving her Thursday board game group, so maybe we could give her a copy of Cascadia as a goodbye present.
I'm taking Nora to her dentist appointment on Wednesday at 10am. Don't forget the parking permit.
Natasha is reading her way through every Booker winner. She's up to 1994 and hated the last one.

Caitlin's dad, Uncle Ray to everyone, turns seventy on 2 March 2027. Caitlin is organising a surprise lunch and wants everyone to chip in for a watch. Her brother Kieran is in charge of booking the restaurant, which worries her, because he forgot their mum's birthday two years running. Ray is a mad Celtic fan, so she's thinking about a cake in green and white.
Spoke to Saanvi after her ballet exam. She thinks she fluffed the adage section, results in about six weeks. I'll send her something cheerful tonight.
Anjali's flatmate Deepa has an audition at the Old Vic next Thursday. Anjali says she's been rehearsing monologues in the kitchen all week.
Gym, laundry, and finish the Murphy report tonight.

Simone is training for the Manchester Half in April. She runs with a club on Tuesday and Thursday evenings and is aiming for under two hours. Last year she pulled her calf three weeks before and had to pull out, so she's being careful this time.
Joanna had her baby scan on Monday and everything looked good. It's a girl! Her partner Mihai cried apparently.
Must ring Aiko about her results day on Thursday.
Manon is a huge Taylor Swift fan and has been to four of the Eras shows. She collects the vinyl variants too.
Oscar's dad passed away last weekend. The funeral is next Friday at 2pm. I need to send flowers and a card to Oscar and his mum.
Zofia passed her driving test on the first go! She's already looking at little second-hand Fiats.

Marisol and Eduardo are hosting a games night this Saturday. They've just bought Wingspan and want to try it with six. I'm bringing snacks. Eduardo takes board games far too seriously and keeps a spreadsheet of everyone's scores going back to 2023. Marisol prefers co-op games like Pandemic, so expect a bit of a debate about what we play first.
Kieran is doing a ukulele grade 3 exam in the spring. He's sixty-two and very proud of it.
Met Santiago's partner Erin for the first time. She works as a vet nurse and is vegetarian. Lovely, very funny.

Esther has a black belt grading in judo on 8 December 2026. She's been training four nights a week and is terrified. Her coach thinks she's ready, but she failed the last grading by a single throw and hasn't stopped thinking about it. Her husband Kenji is driving her to Sheffield for it. Remember to wish her luck the day before.
Eilidh is doing her Duke of Edinburgh Gold expedition next month. Her mum Fiona is a nervous wreck about it.
Nothing much today. Rained all afternoon, made soup, watched the rugby.
Callum's driving test is tomorrow at 8:40. Don't forget to text him good luck first thing, then ask how it went in the evening.

Aditi is into bouldering and goes to the wall on Sundays with Kenji and his sister Aiko. Kenji is far better than both of them and doesn't let them forget it. Aiko is training for her first competition at the Climbing Hangar on 14 February 2027 and asked if I'd come and watch. She's nervous but says having friends there helps.
Sinead's wedding has been called off. She and Kieran split up a couple of weeks ago. She seems okay but is staying with her parents for now.
Natasha's son Owen starts his apprenticeship on Monday. She said he's quietly excited.
Book Saanvi's birthday dinner for next Saturday. She's mentioned the Lebanese place twice, so that's the hint.
Deepa finally heard back from the bar exam. She passed! Her parents are throwing a party on 21 November 2026.
Jada's grandad is in hospital after a fall. She's going up to Leeds tomorrow to see him and will be there until Wednesday.
Kasia sews all her own clothes now. She's on the Great British Sewing Bee waitlist and would love a new overlocker one day.
Need to renew my passport before March 2027.
Abdi, his wife Zofia and their twins are off to Japan for three weeks over Easter. Abdi has been learning Japanese on Duolingo since June and can apparently order ramen with confidence now.

Yuki's music theory exam was on Saturday. She said it was fine but the harmony question threw her. Results due in a fortnight. Her teacher Mrs Osei thinks she'll scrape a merit, which would be enough for her place on the music course starting in September. Her mum is less sure. Check in with her when they come out.

Talked to Mrs Gonzalez next door. Her son Santiago is sitting the civil service entrance test on Friday and she asked me to pray for him. She also mentioned her knee is playing up again, so maybe offer to do her shopping this weekend.

Called Esther tonight. Her daughter Caitlin got a first in her law degree, graduation is in July 2027. Esther wants to buy her a nice pen and asked for ideas. Caitlin likes fountain pens, so maybe a Lamy.
